relations: A steady white plume rises from the horizon near center and holds its vertical position throughout the clip.
Above the plume, a blue-white spark ring surrounds a central core that flares brighter before fading as the ring dims and contracts inward.
A separate upper starburst flares higher in the sky and expands into a flower-like cluster of white petals while lower blue sparks thin away.
A faint isolated dot hangs high near the top center and remains unmoving against the dark, cloud-streaked sky.
caption: The video captures a night fireworks display against a dark, cloud-streaked sky above a silhouetted skyline, with a low bridge and faint water reflection in the foreground. A steady white plume rises from the horizon near the center and holds its position throughout the clip. Above the plume, a wide ring of blue-white sparks surrounds a central white core that flares brighter before fading as the ring dims and contracts inward. A faint isolated dot hangs high near the top center, unmoving. As the lower ring fades, a separate starburst flares higher in the sky and resolves into a flower-like cluster of white petals. This upper burst steadily expands and brightens while the blue sparks below thin away. The fixed camera keeps the skyline and bridge steady as the two effects evolve at different heights.
